note: Poses: the body origin is the left IR camera's optical centre; the Gemini 2 datasheet does not say which IR camera the depth map is referenced to (the Gemini 330 datasheet, same maker, puts the depth origin at the left IR): the left IR as reference is an ASSUMPTION. The right IR sits one stated baseline (50 mm) along -y. The RGB camera and the laser projector (LDM) are placed by the front-view drawing (Figure 3-1-8, Appendix II): RGB 14 mm (25 - 11) and LDM 25 mm from the left IR toward the right IR; their vertical and axial offsets are not dimensioned and are taken as zero, so both carry pose_stated false (lateral offset from the drawing, the rest an ASSUMPTION). Depth technology: the product page says "Active Stereo IR", the datasheet "active stereo" and "Stereo Structure Light" (an IR speckle projector with stereo IR cameras): entered as active_ir_stereo. IR FOV: 94/66.5/102 deg H/V/D in the specification table (entered) vs 94/68/104 in the IR camera table (3.4.1). Depth FOV 91/66/101 deg +/- 3 deg at 2 m; the depth FOV grows with distance (section 2.4). Depth accuracy "< 2% (1280 x 800 @ 2m & 81% ROI)" is an RMS plane-fit figure by the datasheet's note [2]; the product page calls it "Precision". min_z is empty: the maker states no per-resolution minimum; depth range 0.15-10 m, ideal range 0.2-5 m, and per depth mode ideal ranges 0.20-5.0 m (Unbinned Dense/Sparse Default, Obstacle Avoidance) and 0.15-2.5 m (Binned Sparse Default). 60 fps streams only in Binned Sparse Default. Depth is sent as Y14 or RLE (the table reads "Y14H14"; the packing on the wire is not stated, so bits_per_pixel is null; the SDK outputs Y16); IR as Y8 ("Y8H8") or MJPEG; colour as MJPEG or YUYV (YUYV entered, 16 bits per pixel from 8-bit 4:2:2). USB 3.0 tables entered (USB 2.0 has fewer modes). Power: typical average < 2.0 W, max average < 2.5 W (entered; product page average < 2.5 W), peak < 6.5 W. Mass 97 g +/- 3 g (datasheet, entered) vs 98 g (product page). Size L90 x W25 x D30 mm (the dimension table reads width 90, height 25, depth 30). Depth start point 4.23 mm behind the front of the module (0.7 mm cover glass), entered as depth_start_mm. Projector: VCSEL, 850 nm, 101 x 72.5 deg +/- 3 deg. Lens model pinhole is a labelled ASSUMPTION (no distortion stated). Not stated: pixel size, f-numbers, subpixel accuracy.
